# SOC 1, SOC 2 & SOC 3 certification

## ECM secure in the cloud

Doxis Cloud Services have been successfully certified according to the international SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 1 & 2 and SOC 3 standards, confirms the independent auditing firm CyberGuard Compliance LLP in its audit report. A "type 1" certification refers to the successful testing of the control system itself. In receiving the SOC 2 Type 2 certification Doxis continuously and fully demonstrates in annual reviews that it consistently applies the effective controls and processes, to ensure the highest level of security and availability in the cloud.

## The highest cloud standards

Doxis takes the security and availability of its customers’ data very seriously, particularly when it comes to the cloud. Doxis Cloud Services provide a modern cloud infrastructure for high availability and security to manage databases, servers, storage and networks. SOC 1 Typ 2, SOC 2 Typ 1 & 2 and SOC 3 attest that the controls of Doxis Cloud Services are suitably designed and implemented.

[Download the SOC 3 Report here](https://www.doxis.com/en/medialibrary/soc-3-report-2739 "SOC 3 Report")

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/w/21972-312_SOC_NonCPA_500x500-1x5jmv5k2hxy6qz.png)

### Doxis fulfills SOC 2 "trust service principles"

With SOC 2 certification, Doxis fulfills the 5 principles of security, availability, integrity, confidentiality and privacy.

### Security according to global standards

As a premium vendor, we guarantee that our cloud services are provided according to the most up-to-date international standards.

### SOC 2 paves the way to SaaS

More and more customers seek the flexibility of a SaaS solution, but do not wish to risk mishandled data or cyberattacks. SOC 2 provides the necessary assurance.

### Continuous monitoring

Doxis regularly monitors, measures, analyzes and updates its Doxis Cloud Services to ensure the highest level of security, performance and fail-safety.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/t/gregor_joeris_600x600_schraeg-yayqxaryxr3w6ee.jpg)

> Security and compliance for our customers is our number one priority. For this reason, we are constantly monitoring, analyzing and updating our Doxis Cloud Services. The intense auditing process of the SOC 2 certification demonstrates this.
>
> _Dr. Gregor Joeris, CTO of Doxis_
